outcome.passRule: at least 60% seeded-defect recall, at least 50% finding precision, and all critical seeds detected
outcome.rankingRule: pass rate, mean severityWeightedRecall, mean findingPrecision, list-price cost, duration, stable variant id

evidenceInputs.use: second defect mix and isolation/reliability coverage
per-model QS precision context only; excluded from recall and controlled ranking

limitations: The pilot has two small synthetic C# files and cannot establish repository-scale review ability.

The original tenant-transfer run is excluded because its diff-oriented prompt failed to identify the supplied snapshot as the review subject and its Sol/xhigh attempt exceeded the then-active measurement cap.
Keyword and line-neighborhood matching can undercount a semantically correct finding expressed far from the seeded line.
QS confirmed/dismissed findings measure sighted-finding precision and cannot reveal missed defects.
